import json,os,pathlib,subprocess,time,shutil,concurrent.futures,threading
svc='jellyfin-pink.service'
root=pathlib.Path('/srv/projects/jellyfin-server')
def run(args,timeout=12):
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
  return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:return 124,'','timeout'
def prop(name):
 c,v,_=run(['systemctl','show',svc,'-p',name,'--value'])
 return v.strip() if c==0 else None
def health():
 return {s:run(['systemctl','is-active',s])[1].strip() for s in ('vivoapk-backend.service',svc,'nginx.service','postgresql.service')}
def mem_available():
 for line in pathlib.Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines():
  if line.startswith('MemAvailable:'):
   return int(line.split()[1])*1024
 return 0
before=health()
assert prop('User')=='jellyfinpink' and all(v=='active' for v in before.values())
cpus=os.cpu_count() or 1
load=os.getloadavg()[0]
mem=mem_available()
result={'scope':'two simultaneous bounded synthetic HD encoders outside production service cgroup; no customer streams, credentials, media files, or production configuration changes','cpu_count':cpus,'load_before':round(load,2),'memory_available_before_bytes':mem,'services_before':before,'duration_seconds_each':6,'resolution':'1280x720','fps':25,'encoder_threads_each':1}
if cpus<4 or mem<1024*1024*1024 or load>=cpus*0.5:
 result.update(status='skipped_resource_gate',services_after=health())
 print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
else:
 barrier=threading.Barrier(2,timeout=5)
 def test(index):
  cmd=['sudo','-n','-u','jellyfinpink','--','/usr/bin/ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-nostdin','-v','error','-nostats','-progress','pipe:1','-filter_threads','1','-filter_complex_threads','1','-f','lavfi','-i','testsrc2=size=1280x720:rate=25','-f','lavfi','-i',f'sine=frequency={440+index*110}:sample_rate=48000','-t','6','-c:v','libx264','-threads:v','1','-preset','veryfast','-pix_fmt','yuv420p','-b:v','2500k','-c:a','aac','-b:a','128k','-threads:a','1','-f','null','-']
  barrier.wait()
  start=time.monotonic()
  c,o,e=run(cmd,25)
  elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
  fields={}
  for line in o.splitlines():
   k,sep,v=line.partition('=')
   if sep:fields[k]=v
  frames=int(fields.get('frame','0').strip() or '0')
  return {'job':index,'exit':c,'frames':frames,'elapsed_seconds':round(elapsed,3),'speed':fields.get('speed','').strip(),'wall_time_factor':round(6/elapsed,2),'finished':fields.get('progress')=='end'}
 start=time.monotonic()
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
  jobs=list(pool.map(test,(1,2)))
 result.update(benchmarks=jobs,elapsed_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start,3),services_after=health(),memory_available_after_bytes=mem_available())
 assert result['services_after']==before
 passed=all(r['exit']==0 and r['frames']>=150 and r['finished'] for r in jobs)
 result['status']='completed' if passed else 'partial'
 result['both_realtime_in_short_test']=passed and all(r['wall_time_factor']>=1 for r in jobs)
 print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
 assert passed
